import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_58/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_58/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' and aggregate:
# sum of fare (float), max of ride_id (int), sum of driver_count (int)
agg = joined.groupby("type").agg({
    "fare": "sum",
    "ride_id": "max",
    "driver_count": "sum"
}).reset_index()

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
agg["type"] = agg["type"].astype(str)
agg["fare"] = agg["fare"].astype(float)
agg["ride_id"] = agg["ride_id"].astype(int)
agg["driver_count"] = agg["driver_count"].astype(int)

# Rename columns to match target schema (already matching)
Target2_58 = agg[["type", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]

# Write to target CSV
Target2_58.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_58/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
